title: English Practice Quiz 0906
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which sentence is appropriate for a formal inspection report?
options: The inspection identified three maintenance issues.
questions.explanation: The inspection identified three maintenance issues. is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A business proposal should explain ___.
options: the need, suggested solution and expected benefits
questions.explanation: the need, suggested solution and expected benefits is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A memo is commonly used for ___.
questions.explanation: internal communication within an organisation is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Complete the formal phrase: 'Please ___ receipt of this document.'
questions.explanation: acknowledge is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A formal report heading should be ___.
options: specific and relevant to the subject
questions.explanation: specific and relevant to the subject is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Consistency in editing means ___.
options: using the same style for similar elements
questions.explanation: using the same style for similar elements is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly describes a committee decision?
options: The committee have approve the proposal.
The committee are approves the proposal.
The committee has approved the proposal.
questions.explanation: The committee has approved the proposal. is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A supporting appendix usually contains ___.
options: additional material relevant to the main document
questions.explanation: additional material relevant to the main document is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A formal request should state ___.
options: what is needed and any relevant deadline
questions.explanation: what is needed and any relevant deadline is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Proofreading should include checking spelling, grammar and ___.
options: accuracy of names, dates and figures
questions.explanation: accuracy of names, dates and figures is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
